title: evidence.audit_requested (v1)
description: ResearchOrchestrator instructs EvidenceAuditAgent to audit claim-citation support in the reinterpreted ResearchSpec against the literature. Payload is intentionally minimal: the ResearchSpec, LiteratureBrief, and SpecInterpretation are read from the Research Store by ref rather than from this payload. EvidenceAuditAgent itself is out of scope for this task -- this is the frozen contract only; no consumer wired yet.

research_spec_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen (possibly revised) ResearchSpec object.

literature_brief_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen LiteratureBrief object.

spec_interpretation_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen SpecInterpretation object.

method_ref.description: Frozen method being audited when method-level novelty is active.
